_readme: The chain is tried top to bottom on every request: best model first, smallest last.
A model that hits a rate limit or errors is put on cooldown and skipped; as soon as its
cooldown ends it is used again, so Zyqra always returns to the best model that is available.
TO ADD A MODEL:    add one line to "chain" at the position you want it tried.
TO ADD A PROVIDER: add an entry to "providers" (any OpenAI-compatible API works), put its
key in backend/.env under the name given in "key_env", then add its models to "chain".
MORE QUOTA:        a key variable may hold several keys separated by commas; each is tried in turn.
Models from a provider with no key in .env are skipped automatically, so it is safe to leave
them listed. This file is re-read whenever it changes - no server restart needed.
Provider options: name, base_url, key_env, signup_url, free_tier (shown in Settings),
daily_reset_utc_hour (hour the daily quota resets, UTC), max_input_chars (trim long chats
for providers with a small tokens-per-minute limit), headers (extra HTTP headers).
base_url may contain {ENV_VAR} placeholders, filled from .env.
Model options: provider, model (exact API id), label, tier (flagship|strong|fast|light|backup),
enabled (false to switch a model off), max_input_chars.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.free_tier: Free, no card. Limits are per model and shown in AI Studio; daily quota resets at midnight Pacific.

groq.name: Groq
groq.free_tier: Free, no card. About 30 requests/min and 1,000 requests/day per model; very fast.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA NIM
nvidia.free_tier: Free endpoints, about 40 requests/min. Meant for prototyping.

mistral.name: Mistral AI
mistral.free_tier: Free plan, no card. Monthly free allowance; exact limits are shown in the Mistral console.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.free_tier: Models ending in :free. 20 requests/min and 50 requests/day (1,000/day after a one-time $10 top-up).

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare.free_tier: 10,000 Neurons/day shared across models, resets 00:00 UTC. Needs CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID too.
